summary: Import-time exfiltration of AWS IMDS credentials, Kubernetes secrets, and environment variables to attacker-controlled domain
details: On any require()/import of this package, index.js top-level code harvests AWS EC2 instance metadata via IMDSv2 (IAM role security-credentials, identity-credentials, user-data, instance-identity document, network interface details), reads all files under /var/run/secrets/ (Kubernetes service-account tokens and mounted secret material), and serializes process.env, then POSTs the collected data to the hardcoded endpoint https://hrnmn.dd.h4x.tv/save_instance_info_from_pkge_hrmony_pladddform-core. A preliminary beacon POST to the same host confirms installer reachability before the credential-collection phase. The package name and its declared dependency @hrmony/kit-5 have the shape of typosquats against a private @hrmony scope, consistent with a dependency-confusion attack against internal build systems running in AWS/Kubernetes environments.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
